why: A linkage record marked not loaded is read anyway. Loaded is false exactly when the read never happened (the anonymous audit), so whatever stale or fixture data sits in `open` becomes an in-flight verdict. Absence of data must never be a finding.
killedBy: Now eligibility reasons cannot report native-blocked or in-flight from data that was never loaded
Now queue invariants beyond readiness and blockers does not invent an in-flight error when linkage was not inspected
promotion candidacy cannot call a candidate in flight when pull-request linkage was not inspected
